name: fission-marketplace

metadata.description: Fission Labs' private catalogue of agentic skills. Three bundles: design-system (generic, brand-agnostic component skills), fl-design-system (Fission's own setup + token/registry data), and frontend-common (framework-independent debugging/exploring/knowledge-lookup, plus the gate for framework-specific upstream installs). Standards and delivery bundles are deferred to a later round — see README.

plugins.name: design-system
plugins.description: Design-system-agnostic UI component skills (Button, Input, Card, Dialog, Table, Form, Badge, Select, Tabs, Toast) — detects and adapts to whatever design system a project already uses (a registered branded shadcn registry, bare shadcn, MUI, Chakra, AntD, or plain CSS). No Fission-specific logic; Fission's own registry is just one registered entry.

plugins.name: fl-design-system
plugins.description: Fission's own design system — scaffold a new project on it, or install/update its branded shadcn components into an existing one. Pairs with design-system, which detects and consumes it automatically once set up.

plugins.name: frontend-common
plugins.description: Framework-independent frontend skills (debugging, codebase exploration, knowledge lookup) plus the confirmation gate for framework-specific upstream installs (React/Next/Angular/Vue), so a project only ever gets the upstream bundle matching its actual stack.

_comment_upstream: High-level/non-component framework skills (React & Next.js practices, accessibility, framework upgrades, library-version-matched guidance) are NOT built here — they're already published by their maintainers (Vercel, TanStack). See UPSTREAM.md for the install commands, and frontend-common's fe-upstream-setup skill for how a project is gated to only the matching one. This marketplace only carries what's unique to Fission's own component library and framework-agnostic process, per the proposal's three-question rule.
